stepExplanation: Using Faraday's Law: EMF = -N * (change in flux / change in time) = -200 * (-0.015 / 0.2) = -200 * (-0.075) = 15 V. The magnitude of induced EMF is 15 V.
stepBody: Apply Faraday's Law: EMF = -N * (change in flux / change in time), where N = 200 turns, change in flux = -0.015 Wb, and time = 0.2 s. What is the magnitude of the induced EMF?
